svg.text: PAINTED SPLITTER ISLANDS MAY BE USED WHEN SITE
GEOMETRY LEADS TO ISLANDS LESS THAN 50 SF IN SIZE.
USE DIMENSION SCHEDULE ON SHEET 4 OF 4 AS A DESIGN
GUIDE. FINAL DIMENSIONS TO BE DETERMINED BY THE
WHERE CROSSING STREETS ARE NOT THE SAME WIDTH,
CONSIDER CURB EXTENSIONS ON WIDER ROAD TO CREATE
TYPE D PAVEMENT MARKERS PLACED ON THE YELLOW
CENTERLINE ARE REQUIRED FOR PAINTED CENTER ISLANDS
AND SPLITTER ISLANDS AND RECOMMENDED FOR RAISED
